An elderly Indian grandmother in a faded cotton saree, natural skin texture with pores and fine wrinkles, sits on a low wooden stool and mixes fresh goat meat pieces with turmeric and spices by hand in a large brass vessel. Medium-wide shot, face not in close-up, nobody talking to camera, hands busy, the meat in focus.
